value.rationale: The robust maximin captures two fixed number-state detection channels with one finite-area aperture. It has a sharp adjacent-versus-nonadjacent spectral-geometry transition, exact proportions of area at two separated radii, a universal rigidity law for near-optimal masks, and an exponentially increasing loss for single-ring designs at high excitation. These are natural structural and quantitative invariants; the result is not merely an evaluation of one Gaussian integral.
